title: Categories section
description: Three rows of category chips that scroll without end, the middle one the other way. Each chip’s icon plays when you hover over it.

fragments.title: Define the element
fragments.note: Built-in triggers only. Apart from the glide call, this is the whole script.

fragments.title: A row of chips
fragments.note: target points the icon at its chip, so the whole chip is the hover area. Two copies of the set follow, hidden from the keyboard and from screen readers.

fragments.title: The endless scroll
fragments.note: The track moves by one set and starts over. Only transform changes, so the browser does not repaint.

fragments.title: Slow to a stop, then pick up
fragments.note: Only the playback rate of the CSS animation changes. It eases out to 0 under the pointer or keyboard focus and eases back in afterwards.

fragments.title: Chip colours
fragments.note: One custom property per chip. Hover mixes it with black; the icon follows the text colour.
